'''Meihanna Island''' was an island located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]] near the [[Geharran city continent]]. The island was a nature preserve and retreat for the planet's [[Geharran royal family|royal family]]. After the disappearance of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Nehanna]], [[Gender/Legends|her]] son, [[Ebrahi]], lived on the island until he reached adulthood.<ref name="Strongholds" />
